description: This file defines the 'ModuleClassLoader' class which extends URLClassLoader to provide custom class loading logic for modules within the OpenMRS platform. It manages module dependencies, resource loading, caching of libraries, and handles module-specific class visibility and resource accessibility.

classes.name: ModuleClassLoader
classes.description: A custom class loader for handling dynamic loading of module classes and resources within the OpenMRS platform, including dependency management, resource expansion, and caching.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with this class loader.

methods.name: isDisposed
methods.description: Returns whether this class loader has been disposed.

methods.name: setProbeParentLoaderLast
methods.description: Sets whether to probe parent class loader last during class loading.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of this class loader, cleaning up resources and marking it as disposed.

methods.name: getProvidedPackages
methods.description: Returns the set of package names provided by this module.
